status: Physical measurements required. Previous R5E mass-derived performance/CG scenarios retired; no R5F flight-performance or stability qualification.

A26.basis: R5F delivered STEP adaptive volume/centroid; Prusament ASA density1.07g/cm3 reference only, actual spool unknown. Low/high equal nominal because no defensible actual-spool range was established; weigh the final solid print.

A44_L.basis: R5F exact installed CAD volume/centroid; assumed PLA+ density nominal1.24, range1.15-1.30g/cm3; 100% rectilinear print mass still requires weighing.

mass_input_boundary: Only the four changed parts were refreshed from exact source/delivered readbacks. Other retained worksheet rows remain previous planning assumptions, not measurements; their existing centroids have not been reverified in this change.
cg_boundary: Geometric starting point only; not a validated allowable CG range. Measure final assembled aircraft balance and obtain experienced pilot acceptance.
required_physical_evidence: Weigh final installed parts and whole aircraft; locate measured final CG.
Qualify printed ribs, wood bonds, rods and moving-control retention under the agreed structural proof load.
Measure exact 4S/9045 three-blade/40A ESC system current, thrust, vibration and temperature before flight.
Complete deferred landing-gear fit, clearance, steering and taxi checks after midsems.
